design_goal.primary: Explore fixed-length APH(3')-IIa variants while preserving the P00552 fold, the experimentally observed 1ND4 kanamycin pocket, the verified catalytic/Mg context, and the known kanamycin-compatible label boundary.
design_goal.formal_success_definition: A candidate is feasible only if it obeys the active tier's controller-owned position/amino-acid contract, keeps every globally frozen residue unchanged, passes matched-protocol fold/core/KAN/Mg/clash gates in the primary chain-A state, and does not fail the chain-B repeat audit. Sequence likelihood, DMS-label compatibility, diversity, and island specialization order candidates only after global feasibility.
